timeline.summary: R Systems International Limited schedules Investors/Analysts call on May 07, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. (IST) to discuss Q4FY26 results.
R Systems' composite scheme to amalgamate Velotio Technologies and Scaleworx Technologies became effective May 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹574.77 Cr, net profit ₹65.41 Cr.
R Systems reported Q1 2026 consolidated revenue of ₹574.77 Cr and PAT of ₹65.41 Cr
R Systems International reported Q1 2026 consolidated revenue of ₹574.8 Cr (+29.9% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of ₹115.7 Cr.
R Systems International scheduled its 32nd AGM for June 25, 2026.
R Systems International Limited schedules an Analysts/Investor Meet on November 04, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. (IST) to discuss Q2 and Q3FY27 results.
